Professional fundraising in a market

Source: R/composition-metrics.R
get_fundraising_ratio.Rd

Use of paid fundraisers and the contributions they bring in. Replaces the legacy get_fundraising_efficiency().

Usage

get_fundraising_ratio(
  df,
  geography = "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS",
  subsector = "NTEEV2",
  year = "TAXYEAR",
  contributions = "REVCONT",
  fees = "FNDFEE"
)

Arguments

df

A data frame with one row per organization-year.

geography

Name of the column that identifies the market's geography, such as "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS" or "COUNTY_FIPS".

subsector

Name of the column that identifies the subsector. When it is "NTEEV2", the first three characters (the major group) are used.

year

Name of the column that identifies the year, such as "TAXYEAR".

contributions

Contributions and grants column.

fees

Professional fundraising fees column.

Value

A tibble with GEO, SUB, YEAR, N_FEE (organizations that report the fee line), FUNDRAISER_SHARE (share of those paying professional fundraisers) and FUNDRAISING_RATIO (contributions per dollar of professional fundraising fees, among organizations that pay fees).

Details

Professional fundraising fees are reported only on the full Form 990, so Form 990-EZ filers are excluded, and only a few percent of filers pay such fees. Markets with no fee-paying organizations get FUNDRAISING_RATIO = NA. The fee line does not include in-house fundraising staff, so this is not total fundraising efficiency.

Examples

fr <- get_fundraising_ratio( npo_panel_sample, geography = "COUNTY_FIPS",
                             year = "TAXYEAR", fees = "FNDFEE" )
head( fr[ fr$SUB == "ALL", ] )
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   GEO   SUB    YEAR N_FEE FUNDRAISER_SHARE FUNDRAISING_RATIO
#>   <chr> <chr> <int> <int>            <dbl>             <dbl>
#> 1 50001 ALL    2015    71           0.0141            1488. 
#> 2 50001 ALL    2016    68           0.0147            8708. 
#> 3 50001 ALL    2017    71           0.0282             111. 
#> 4 50001 ALL    2018    73           0.0411              38.0
#> 5 50001 ALL    2019    75           0.0533              52.3
#> 6 50003 ALL    2015    85           0.0118              13.0
